Indian national Nikhil Gupta was sentenced to 235 months in prison on November 20, 2026, by a U.S. court for his involvement in a murder-for-hire plot targeting Sikh separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in New York. Gupta pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire, conspiracy and money laundering charges earlier this year.
Thank you for watching our video!
